blocks.text: Second of three parts PART I: The state of Philippine news: Trust falls amid changing media habits MANILA, Philippines — The press faces an immense challenge in reaching more people at a time when fewer Filipinos trust the news, interest is waning and social media has become the dominant gateway to information. Based on the latest Digital News Report of the Reuters Institute, only 28% of Filipino respondents said they trusted most news most of the time, down from 38% in 2025 and the steepest decline among the 48 markets surveyed.
